From the harpers index:

> Estimated combined cost of the three most expensive Democratic Senate primary races this year : $180,000,000
November 2026 • Source: VoteLog (Oklahoma City)

> Average percentage by which the winner was outspent by the runner-up : 215
November 2026 • Source: VoteLog (Oklahoma City)

> Average margin of victory, in percentage points, for those winners : 9.3

Thankfully I am getting outspent in my local water board campaign to a nontrivial degree! 

Funnily enough I met a fairly active community member earlier tonight and they had this to say about my opponents mailer: where did they get the money? What's their agenda? Can't trust them. (Paraphrasing)
